<thought>We need the number of aromatic carbons in the molecule, but we have no structural information. The only way to infer it is to obtain the 13C NMR spectrum for the sample, which should show distinct signals for aromatic carbons (typically in the 110‑160 ppm region). By counting those signals we can determine the aromatic carbon count. We'll request the carbon NMR spectrum.</thought>
